A stabilizing unit for extreme-voltage wireless power. 
Radical!

A stabilizing unit for high-voltage wireless power.
One could say, this is quite shocking!
item.phoenix_tesla_network.iv_tesla_stab:
A stabilizing unit for insane-voltage wireless power.
Crazy? I was crazy once.

Your progress is quite impressive! Keep going!

Is this even useful?

There is nothing beyond this.

You probably won't use this.
